\[
|A| = 3\cdot 2^6 - \binom{3}{2}2^3 + 1 = 192 - 24 + 1 = 169
\]
Similarly, \(|B|=169\). Since a row all heads and a column all tails cannot coexist, \(|A \cap B|=0\).

Thus the desired count is
\[
512 - 169 - 169 + 0 = 174.
\]
So
\[
p=\frac{174}{512}=\frac{87}{256}.
\]
Hence
\[
100a+b = 100(87)+256 = 8956.
\]

\[
\boxed{8956}
